usage: agentbreeder traces [-h] [--state-dir STATE_DIR] [--json]
                           [--trace TRACE_ID] [--stack DIR]
                           [--environment ENVIRONMENT] [--last N] [--since D]
                           [--project NAME]
                           [ID]

positional arguments:
  ID                    Deployment ID (from `list`): its newest traces

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --json
  --trace TRACE_ID      One trace (32 hex, as a turn returns it), as a tree
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
                        With --stack: the stack environment
  --last N              The newest N traces per deployment (default 20, at
                        most 200)
  --since D             Only traces started since D (2026-11-13 or an ISO
                        time, UTC)
  --project NAME        With --trace: the Phoenix project (the agent name)
